title: Add Ink or Engine to games
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Ink or Engine](https://ink-or-engine-metamysteries8.endoxidev.chatgpt.site) to games
- Free timed real-or-AI text game. Pollinations generated all 12 fakes. API source: https://github.com/MetaMysteries8/ink-or-engine/blob/main/generate.mjs

Fixes #15871, fixes #15725

gist.headline: Ink meets the guessing game
gist.blurb: Ink or Engine joins the games collection: a timed challenge to spot real writing among 12 Pollinations-generated fakes. The clock is not especially sympathetic.
gist.summary: Adds MetaMysteries8's free timed real-or-AI text game, Ink or Engine, to the games collection; Pollinations generated all 12 fake passages.
gist.impact: Players get a timed game where they try to distinguish real writing from 12 AI-generated fakes.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Ink or Engine as a cozy guessing table with two passage cards—one beside an ink bottle, one beside a friendly CRT robot—and a small timer. Polli studies the cards with a tiny detective hat; lime-green code-plants and flowers connect the writing game to Pollinations.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden café, Polli studies two passage cards beside an ink bottle, a friendly CRT monitor robot, and a little ticking timer, wearing a tiny detective hat; lime green (#ecf874) code-plants bloom around the table. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, in strictly pixel art style—cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with dark purple (#110518) outlines and a warm cream background.
